name: Confectionery Secrets
source:
ConfectionerySecrets is a  small game about a bakery.  You'll play as Celeste, a young woman who finds herself drawn into the mysterious world of her grandmother's bakery.

As you delve deeper into the story, you'll encounter Leah who appears to be a lively and enigmatic character.  But appearances can be deceiving, and what starts as a cozy adventure quickly takes a twisted turn.

Uncover the truth about Leah and navigate the treacherous path between a cozy reality and a nightmarish fantasy. Will Celeste find her way out, or will she be trapped forever in her own beloved dream turned into a nightmare?

[from [url=https://blue-strawberry.itch.io/confectionery-secrets]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Confectionery Secrets》是一款关于烘焙店的小型游戏。你将扮演年轻女性塞莱斯特，发现自己被卷入祖母烘焙店的神秘世界。

随着故事深入，你会遇见莉娅，一个看似活泼却神秘的角色。但表象可能骗人，原本温馨的冒险，很快走向扭曲。

揭开莉娅的真相，在温暖现实与噩梦幻想之间的险路上前行。塞莱斯特能找到出路吗？还是会永远困在自己深爱、却已化为噩梦的梦境中？

[摘自[url=https://blue-strawberry.itch.io/confectionery-secrets]itch.io[/url]]
